component.internal-name: software — We start with the workflow, not the buzzwords.
component.heading_t: We start with the workflow, not the buzzwords.
component.subtitle_t: IoT, microservices, ETL, dashboards, and AI are implementation choices. The first question is always what outcome the software has to produce.

item.text_t: We identify who uses the system, what decisions they make, and where the current process breaks down.
We find where data starts, where it needs to go, who trusts it, and what needs validation.
We choose the simplest architecture that supports the workflow, scale, integrations, and future change.
We use AI-assisted development to move faster and AI-agent QA to keep critical flows under watch.
